Game Overview

In Lovo, the core idea is straightforward: leap into the sky with LOVO, a charming hero on a nest-hopping adventure. Strategically dodge adversarial animals and uncover hidden power-ups in eggs. With intuitive swipe controls, thrilling gameplay challenges your precision and timing as you climb higher, face new foes, and set record-breaking altitudes.
